latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Orchestrates the end-to-end customer discovery process for systematically validating a business idea through real customer conversations.

- Guides users step-by-step before, during, and after customer meetings
- Produces and updates a discovery status dashboard to track validation progress
- Delegates specialized tasks to sibling skills (e.g., segmenting customers, designing interview questions, analyzing conversation quality)
- Diagnoses broken or unproductive discovery processes using defined warning signs
- Flexible entry—supports users starting from scratch or assessing ongoing discovery efforts
